proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka's stated goal was a universal science unifying all knowledge, whose lettrist component would allow decipherment of the twin Books (Quran and cosmos) and, in MK's phrase, the writing of the future and rewriting of reality.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, author of Ibn Turka's lettrist and universalist works
mediation.where: Ibn Turka's lettrist and universalist works
mediation.note: A doctrinal work, not addressed to a judge; the duress rule counts a work as evidence of what he held.
We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
